item.title: Vanitas no Hitsuji
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: RococoWorks
  • 発売日: 2011-04-22
  • スコア: 6.659999999999999/10 (32 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ヴァニタスの羊
  • 英語名: Vanitas no Hitsuji

别名

  • Sheep of Vanitas

あらすじ

Claude goes on a journey with the one he calls father, Eliphas, a magician who can alter other people’s awareness, making them think illusions are reality. When he was walking the streets of Engelbourg, he noticed something sticking out from an empty barrel. A couple guys asked him if he saw a girl around and he used his ‘color magic’ to trick their eyes and save the girl, Therese. At that time, he didn’t know that this chance meeting would have a profound effect on the fortress city, nor that there were engels (angels) sleeping there.
